newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end firm, led by Banco Ganadero.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end firm, led by Banco Ganadero.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged up in lackluster trading led by Banco Ganadero, the country's largest bank in terms of assets.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index finished ahead 0.14 percent at 18,293.98 amid volume of 1.9 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index closed up 0.33 percent at 1,201.86 on below average trading of 1.6 billion pesos.
One of the day's biggest gainers was Banco Ganadero, which finished up 1.01 percent at 400 in Bogota and up 2.15 percent to 402.50 in Medellin.
Banco de Colombia, the second largest bank in terms of assets, was unchanged at 395 in Bogota and in Medellin.
Dealers said Banco de Colombia was selling about 25 pesos below value, but had yet to attract the attention of speculators.
Brewing giant Bavaria was unchanged at 8,200 in Bogota, but closed up 0.60 percent at 8,250 in Medellin.
